prompt:
Build an engine-driven road-vehicle model in Simulink and Simscape Driveline with a six-forward-speed dual-clutch transmission. The physical drivetrain must contain two distinct controllable friction-clutch power paths serving interleaved odd and even gear ratios, a common transmission output, a final drive, and a vehicle load. Both clutch paths must physically transmit torque, and automatic gear selection and torque transfer must use measured vehicle and drivetrain feedback. The vehicle speed must be controlled in closed loop to follow the requested speed profile. The detailed controller, shift logic, and actuator implementation are not prescribed. Prescribed vehicle motion, direct replay of the requested speed as measured speed, a fixed-ratio or single-clutch drivetrain disguised as a dual-clutch transmission, and disconnected decorative drivetrain components are not valid.

Read speed_command, vehicle_mass_kg, and clutch_capacity_scale from the MATLAB base workspace. speed_command is a complete Timeseries in km/h with values from 0 to 120 km/h. vehicle_mass_kg has a nominal value of 1600 kg and must be supported from 1360 to 1840 kg. clutch_capacity_scale has a nominal value of 1.0 and must be supported from 0.85 to 1.0; it must change the physical torque capacity of both transmission clutches rather than only a reported value. Simulate the complete interval carried by speed_command for every supported operating condition.

Record four complete Timeseries named speed_response, engine_speed, transmission_state, and engine_torque_demand. speed_response contains [requested speed, measured physical vehicle speed] in km/h. engine_speed contains measured physical engine speed in rpm. transmission_state contains [selected gear state, odd-clutch pressure in Pa, even-clutch pressure in Pa, odd-clutch slip in rpm, even-clutch slip in rpm]. engine_torque_demand contains the demanded engine torque in N*m. Every logged signal must come from the same causal simulation and cover the full speed_command interval.

Save the completed model as cand_XMECH03.slx in the submission directory.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XMECH03.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
